theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_fp_offset_plane_ball_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (w : Euclid P) (R : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → w ∈ Vᗮ → ‖w‖ < R → μHE[n] ({y : Euclid P | y - w ∈ V} ∩ ball 0 R) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - ‖w‖ ^ 2) ^ n)
